facts.fact: The World Bank says the Civil Registry Act (2018) and the Civil Registration and National Identification Regulations (2024), with the Nationality Act (2011), have established the legal foundation for South Sudan's identity system; the Act is a statute and the 2024 instrument is regulations.

facts.fact: The World Bank says the Civil Registry Act (2018) and the Civil Registration and National Identification Regulations (2024), with the Nationality Act (2011), provide the legal foundation for an interoperable digital identity system based on a unique Personal Identification Number (PIN).
